## V24NOV2026G — Fix "_syncLoad is not defined" alert (24 Nov 2026)
- Cause: after login, the page asked for the saved prices before the rest of the page had finished loading (slow connection / auto-login), so a 3-second retry hit a loader that did not exist yet and showed the JS Error alert. No prices were changed or lost.
- Fix: the post-login loading now waits until the whole page has loaded, and the retry safely waits instead of failing. Nothing changes in what admin or staff see.
- Tested: admin and staff log in with no alert and no page errors; all scripts pass syntax check.

## V24NOV2026E — List arrival time recorded (24 Nov 2026)
- Rule agreed with Joel: every supplier list gets the time Joel sends it to be loaded (his message time), for every supplier. The first base-oil update of the day is normally around 1:30-2pm MY; a list that arrives before it is measured against that first update, so the market-move protocol only switches on when a further base-oil update is saved after the list arrived.
- Today: Apical received 14:04, KLK 15:09 (shown in the admin box); both stay set by hand at CP10 1,010 as Joel asked.

## V24NOV2026D — Supplier lists stamped with the base oil when they arrived; cleaner market-move layout (24 Nov 2026)
- Replaces the V24NOV2026C set-up with one rule for every supplier and every day: a supplier list carries the time it arrived (`at`), and the app looks up the CP10 saved in the Daily Oil Base Price at that time (if nothing was saved yet that day, the day's first save). A `base` set by hand still overrides (used today for Apical and KLK: CP10 1,010).
- On the list day: price shown = supplier quote + CP10 move since the quote, never below the supplier quote. Only CP10-linked bases are stamped (CP10, RBD palm oil, CP6, Indonesia); stearin, PFAD and lauric bases keep the same-day rule. Normal day (no move): nothing changes, no prompt. Next day: prompt gone.
- Admin, Daily Oil Base Price panel: new "Today's supplier lists vs market" box: per supplier, list received time, CP10 when quoted, market move added, gap vs projection (tap for each SKU). Phone layout wraps per supplier.
- Admin, supplier tab: each affected SKU shows "quote 1,120 · market +15"; one-line notice at the top.
- Staff: one-line notice on the supplier tab (no base-oil figures, no supplier quote); in the confirm-before-copy / PDF screen the affected items are named and marked, and a tick box "I have double-checked the actual cost with the supplier / management" must be ticked before the WhatsApp copy or PDF goes out. Admin is not asked to tick. (Visibility change for User 2/3/4.)
- Tested at CP10 1,025: Apical 36/39 1,135 (quote 1,120), KLK CP10 flexibag 1,088 (quote 1,073), KLK stearin 1,039 (not stamped); stamp lookup: list at 11:00 -> 1,010 (09:30 save), at 08:00 -> 1,010 (first save of the day), at 16:00 -> 1,025; staff tick blocks the copy until ticked; admin and staff, desktop and phone, no page errors.

## V24NOV2026C — Supplier quoted at an earlier base oil: price moves with the market, floor and prompts (24 Nov 2026)
- Situation: Apical and KLK sent their 24 Nov lists when CP10 was 1,010; CP10 was then moved to 1,025 (+15). Per Joel: show the price +15 (room to negotiate) and prompt users to double-check the real costing with the supplier. For a drastic same-day move only (temporary); a list without the new setting behaves exactly as before.
- Mechanism: a supplier list can carry `base` (the CP10 the supplier quoted on) and `prompt:true`. The list is applied at that base, so shown price = supplier quote + base-oil move since (Apical and KLK Pasir Gudang SKUs: +15 today; KLK stearin unchanged because stearin did not move after the quote). Gap vs projection is measured at the quoted base, so the log stays true.
- Floor: if the base oil later falls below the quoted base, the price never shows below the supplier's actual quote.
- Prompts: supplier tab banner (admin sees CP10 quoted vs now and the supplier's actual quote on each SKU; staff see a general prompt with no base-oil numbers), warning in the quote review and the final review screen ("double-check the actual costing with the supplier before sending or agreeing a lower price"). They disappear when the base returns to the quoted level or the next list is loaded without the setting.
- Visibility change: staff (User 2/3/4) now see the prompt on Apical / KLK tabs and in quotes that contain those items; they do not see the base-oil figures or the supplier's actual quote.
- List ids bumped to 24NOV26B (Apical, KLK) so the lists re-apply at 1,010: press Save & Log Reference after a hard refresh.
- Tested: Apical 36/39 shows 1,135 (quote 1,120 + 15), Jerry Can CP10 1,305; KLK CP10 flexibag 1,088 (1,073 + 15), Low CP10 1,163 (1,148 + 15); floor holds at 1,120 when base is set to 1,000; no prompt when base = quoted base; admin and staff, no page errors.

## V23NOV2026T (23 Nov 2026)
- **Log Reference now opens on "Date vs Date"** (replaces the Compare & Track tab from S, which duplicated the Compare button; all best-price / quote features removed from the log).
- Pick any two logged dates (FROM X1 / TO X2) or use Last 2 saves / 7 / 30 / 90 / 365 days / Since start. For every supplier product it shows the supplier FOB on each date (the last save on or before that date), the supplier move, the move of that product's own base oil over the same dates, and the **gap vs oil** (0 = moving in tandem). Gaps at or above the flag threshold (default 5, adjustable) are flagged ABOVE / BELOW OIL MOVE; "Out of step with oil only" filter; supplier chips show how many SKUs are out of step.
- Filters: supplier, product search, changed only, sort by gap / move / A-Z. Phone and desktop layouts.
- **Full history:** the log is now loaded page by page from the very first save (previously capped at 20,000 rows). Old tabs also gained a "Since the start" period.
- Staff see supplier FOB and moves only; the base oil box, oil move and gap columns are admin-only.
- Per-supplier review panels remain removed (V23NOV2026S).

## V23NOV2026S (23 Nov 2026) - superseded by T for the Log Reference tab
- **Supplier "review" panels removed** from every supplier tab (supplier list monitor, "Review ... supplier list" button, "to follow up" banner, per-SKU "not on list" / "to confirm" tags). The "new prices loaded" banner is unchanged.

## V07NOV2026T — Customers tab fixed + stale price / outdated freight warnings (8 Nov 2026)
- "Load into Quote" on a saved customer crashed for IOI and Able products (undefined variable, Able not looked up). Now works for all five suppliers and restores each product's FCL and margin.

## [2026-10-19] — Apical 19 Oct supplier list; fix for base oil reverting to old values

### Added
- **Same-day list rule (late base oils).** PK oil, PK olein, coconut etc. are usually entered later in the day (after ~1.30-3pm).
  On the day of a supplier list (Apical 19 Oct, KLK 16 Oct), every base-oil edit re-balances all LISTED SKUs so the system FOB stays equal to
  the supplier's list price. A late base-oil update therefore never shows up as a fake supplier move; save again and the log keeps the
  LAST save of the day. From the next pricing day on, base moves are natural and premiums are no longer re-balanced.
  Unlisted SKUs only move with the base (no uplift is re-applied).
- **Apical 19 Oct 2026 supplier list** (22 rows: Jakarta table 12 + Port Klang table 9 + 40ft HPS), auto-applied on load
  (`premium = supplier FOB − base − packaging`), re-balances live when the base oil is edited, and the premium
  changes (green up / red down) are recorded under Log Reference on **Save & Log Reference**. No uplift.
  New prices: Shortening 36/39 1,200 · 38/40&40/42 1,195 · 43/47 1,195 · 46/48 1,190 · 48/52 1,175 · 18kg Spread Fat
  1,325 · 18kg RCNO 2,150 · HCNO 2,215 · HPS 20ft 1,260 / 40ft 1,275 · Jerry can CP10 1,365 / CP8 1,375 · Hpks 2,595 ·
  Hpko 38/40 2,260 / 40/42 2,265 · Hpkl 41/43 2,120 · CBR 2,010 · Low GE 36/39 1,218 · 38/42 1,225 · 43/48 & 46/48 1,230 · 48/52 1,230.
  Unlisted Apical SKUs keep their premium (they move only with the base oil).

### Fixed

### Added
- Product Table legend: PREM moves only when the supplier moved beyond the base oil; a natural base-oil move is not shown.
  (A FOB line was added to the Product Table and then REMOVED at Joel's request: the log tracks supplier moves only.)
- Apical 19 Oct list **re-applied** (it was reverted briefly by mistake; the saved 19 Oct record already used it).

### Fixed
- **Daily Oil Base Price showing figures 2–3 weeks old instead of the last saved ones.** Cause: if the
  Oil Base (or a supplier) tab was opened before the saved prices finished loading, the sync skipped
  applying them (and every 15-second refresh skipped too), so the page stayed on the built-in starting
  figures. Now the FIRST successful load always applies; failed loads retry (up to 10x, every 3s);
  opening a tab before load triggers a fresh load.
- **Status line** on the Oil Base tab always says which saved prices are on screen
  ("Showing saved prices from 16 Oct 2026, 23:59 (MY) · loaded from the database"), or warns in red that
  they are NOT loaded and may be old.

## [2026-10-17] — Pricing model v2, supplier price lists, Compare, freight, security, many fixes

### Pricing model (the standing rule)
- **Every product on every supplier = base oil + premium/discount (balancing figure) + packaging.**
  Apical, KLK and Wing Agro all priced the same way. FOB = base + premium + packaging (+ fob_delta where set).
- **Model v2 migration** (`MODEL_V=2`): all 98 previously-linked SKUs re-linked to the correct base with the
  premium re-balanced so **no FOB changed** (130 SKUs checked, 0 mismatches). Runs once per saved record.
- **New / fixed bases**: RBD Palm Oil base (Malaysia = CP10 − 10, Indonesia = CP10 − 130); CP6 now always
  CP10 + 60; Indonesia CP10 = CP10 − 120; Ghee and Butter Oil Substitute linked to CP10 + 20; KLK shortening,
  margarine and Palm Oil 36-39 on RBD Palm Oil; stearin flexibags on stearin; Apical standard shortening on
  RBD Palm Oil Indonesia; Apical Low GE & MCPDE shortening on RBD Palm Oil Malaysia.
- **PFAD** price entered by hand (1,052.50 on 16 Oct). `oil_base_log` now also stores cp6, pfad, rbd_my, rbd_id
  (needs the 4 SQL columns; falls back to the old columns if they are missing).

### The "drill" for supplier price lists
- Joel sends a supplier price file -> the list is added to the app -> on load the app **auto-applies it**:
  `premium = supplier FOB − base − packaging`, then **Save & Log Reference** records the premium (green up /
  red down) in the log. Live: base-oil edits re-balance the premiums until saved.
- **KLK 16 Oct list**: 84 SKUs, **+USD 10/MT on every SKU** (list was 13 Oct pricing); the 12 SKUs not on the
  list also get the +10. **Apical 16 Oct list**: 22 rows (Jakarta table + Port Klang table), no uplift.
  Wing Agro: list still to come.
  **The KLK +USD 10/MT is a ONE-OFF adjustment (16 Oct list only, because it was based on 13 Oct pricing).
  It is already inside the saved premiums; future KLK lists get NO uplift.**
- **Monitor strip + orange tags** mark SKUs NOT covered by the latest list ("NOT ON … LIST · +10 ONLY /
  UNCHANGED"). Big banner removed; small save reminder beside the Save button.
- **Apical HPS Flakes 40ft FCL (960 bags)** SKU added at 1,260 (20ft stays 1,245).
- **Apical quality spec shown in brackets** from the supplier file, e.g. HCNO (SMP 29-34), CP8 (IV 58),
  CP10 (IV 56). Display only — the product name underneath is unchanged so history/logs still match.

### Live-day, weekend and saving rules
- The **latest saved pricing day is always live** (weekends never locked). Weekend saves are dated the
  **Friday before** (23:59 MY, in save order). Past-date simulation is read-only and cannot print/copy/save.
- **Unsaved-change guard**: closing/leaving with unsaved base oil/premium/packaging changes prompts User 0.
- **Reset to Last Saved** reloads the shared saved prices (not old code defaults).
- **Margin factor**: Supplier Margin Factor fixed at **0.95** for Apical, KLK, Wing Agro — not editable
  (display/log only; not used in any price calculation).
- **Oillio margin % is independent per supplier** (changing Apical no longer changes KLK/Wing Agro); saved
  on the device as soon as it is changed.

### Logs
- **Last-save-of-the-day** (not average) used in every log table (Product Table, Oil Base Table, Last 90 Days,
  compare). Fixed the bug where two saves on one day showed half the move (+5.62 instead of +11.24).
- Fixed **Product Table blank for Apical Shortening / Low GE**: names containing "&" are now URL-encoded.

## [2026-08-25] — Price history system, base oil tracking, KLK expansion, scroll-jump investigation

### Added
- **`price_log` table** (Supabase): permanent, immutable per-product save history —
  supplier, product, packing, premium, pkg_cost, fob, timestamped, insert-only (no
  update/delete policy)
- **`oil_base_log` table**: same permanent-record pattern for all base commodity
  reference prices (Malaysia CP10, Indonesia CP10, PK Olein, PK Oil, PK Stearin,
  Stearin, Coconut, CP6, PFAD, supplier margin), one row per supplier per save
- **View Log redesign**: 4 independent modes — Browse a single date, standalone
  Product Price History, standalone Oil Base History, Compare Two Dates (shows
  base oil changes and product changes together, colour-coded, labelled with the
  actual selected dates rather than generic "Before/After")
- **Trend Chart**: pick any product + optional date range, see its premium and
  packaging cost as a line chart, base oil reference charted side-by-side
- **Date-range filters** on the full-history list views, so a year of saves doesn't
  need to be scrolled through when only a specific window matters
- **CP6 and PFAD** added as live base-oil commodities under Apical's yellow
  reference box, propagating to WingAgro and KLK automatically (same mechanism as
  the original 7 commodities)
- **Auto-formularised fields**: Indonesia CP10 = Malaysia CP10 − 120, CP6 =
  Malaysia CP10 + 60 — both locked/non-editable, always derived live
- **Packaging Costs & Premiums/Discounts editor**: rebuilt with category tabs
  (Jerry Cans, Shortening, etc.) instead of one long mixed list, so each tab stays
  short and switching categories doesn't require scrolling through everything else

### Changed
- **KLK catalog expanded 81 → 95 products**: full 20-Aug attachment applied — 63
  existing products repriced, CP6 and PFAD Flexibag products switched from static
  to live-reference pricing, 15 new SKUs added (CP6 bottle sizes, PFAD steel
  drums, RBD Palm Oil/Stearin PE liners, Ghee 18L/20L Rec-Tin), one mislabelled
  duplicate ("1.5L X 6" at two different loadings) consolidated into a single
  correct entry
- **Apical**: 24-Aug price update applied (18 products) against a newly-saved
  base oil set (Malaysia CP10 → $1,207.50); 11 other unrelated products
  resynced to their correct live-computed price under the new base oil

### Fixed
- **Stale Supabase snapshot masking correct code prices** — recurring issue this
  session; root cause was a `ref_prices` row that had never been fully refreshed
  since a much earlier save (still showing a 5% Oillio Margin no longer in use).
  Resolved via full-field reset (`apical`/`klk`/`wingagro` → `{}`, `*_pkg` →
  `null`) rather than the narrower single-field patches tried earlier
- **KLK CP6 showing NaN**: the auto-formula assumed the Malaysia CP10 field is
  always named `malaysia_cp10`, but KLK's own reference object calls it `cp10` —
  fixed to resolve either name correctly
- **fcpo_delta double-counting**: when CP6/PFAD products were switched from
  static to live-reference pricing, a leftover structural delta was still being
  added on top of the live value, silently inflating prices — caught during
  verification and corrected across all affected products
- **`price_log` row-limit truncation**: the View Log fetch was capped at 2,000
  rows while the table held 2,681+, silently cutting off the oldest history;
  raised to 20,000
- **Compare view only detecting changes via FOB**: migrated historical rows
  never had FOB stored (only premium/pkg_cost), so genuine premium changes were
  invisible in Compare; fixed to compare premium and packaging directly

### Investigated — background sync disrupting scroll position while viewing the
yellow reference / packaging panels
- Multiple rounds of scroll-preservation fixes attempted (surgical DOM updates
  instead of full re-render, timing via double requestAnimationFrame, dynamic
  detection of whichever element is currently scrolled, staggered multi-attempt
  restores) — none fully resolved it
- Ruled out: browser extensions (reproduced in Incognito with extensions
  disabled), device-specific cause (reproduced on both desktop and mobile),
  full page reload (confirmed via DevTools — no navigation/flash occurs)
- **Root cause found**: the periodic background sync (keeps pricing in sync
  across other users/devices) only paused itself while the user was actively
  *typing* (`_refDirty` flag) — a pure scroll-and-wait session never set that
  flag, so the sync kept re-rendering the panel underneath the user regardless
  of how the re-render itself was made safer
- **Fix**: `_syncApply()` now skips its visual re-render entirely whenever a
  supplier's yellow reference panel is currently visible, not just while
  typing — confirmed this does not affect live cross-supplier propagation
  (`svOnRefChange`) or the Save & Log Reference flow (`svSaveRef`), which are
  separate, untouched code paths

## [2026-06-08] — Flexibag calculations fixed across all outputs

### Fixed
- **Flexibag /1000 bug**: `net_wt` for flexibag is in MT (21.4 MT), not kg.
  All formulas previously divided by 1000 again giving wrong tiny prices.
  - `svCalc()`: added `isFlexibag` 4th param — skips `/1000` when true
  - `calcApicalItemP()`: `fob_ctn = price * nw` (not `/1000`) for flexibag
  - `calcP()` / `calcKlkP()`: `fs = fm * w` (not `/1000`) for flexibag
  - All 7 `svCalc()` call sites updated to pass `isFlex(p.packing)`
  - Added `isFlex()` and `nwLabel()` / `nwFmt()` helper functions
- **Vol(MT)**: `tm = tu * nw` (not `/1000`) — was showing 0.021 instead of 21.4
- **Net Wt label**: All views now show `21.4 MT` not `21.4 kg` for flexibag
- **Cart fob_sku**: Fixed in quotation cart render
- **CIF/MT back-calc**: `/nw` only (not `/nw*1000`) for flexibag
- **PDF USD/MT column**: `fob_mt` in `calcApicalItemP` now includes margin
- **PDF price rows**: Flexibag now shows `USD X/unit | USD Y/MT / USD Z total`

## [2026-06-08] — Ref price persistence fixed (root cause found)

### Fixed
- **Root cause**: `loadRef()` had a sanity check `Math.abs(saved - default) > 30 → reject`
  Any FCPO change >30 USD from the hardcoded default was silently rejected on load,
  reverting prices back to default. This affected ALL users (0, 1, 2) on every login.
- **Fix**: Removed the ±30 sanity check entirely. Saved values now always load if
  `_savedByUser === true` is set.
- **Google Sheets sync**: Already implemented — User 0 saves → pushes to Sheets →
  all users pull on login via `_pullRefFromSheets()` → `_applySheetRef()`
- **Cross-supplier propagation**: Apical save propagates `malaysia_cp10` etc to
  `WA_REF` and `KLK_REF` (and their localStorage keys) automatically
